_doc: QC-67 (OF G1 probe): cower_stand wants a wall 0.21 m behind the root (characters.md) and presses the back against it at the flinch: plain civilian bodies reach up to 0.235 m behind the root through the clip (max_back_m 0.24: at most 3 cm of cloth into the wall, read as leaning on it). Looks carrying a backpack or a bag on the back reach 0.36-0.38 m and push it 15 cm into the wall. offsets.<id> is how far (m) the NPC root steps forward along its facing when it plays cower_stand at a cower point, so its back stays within max_back_m. Ids not listed: 0. Hand-maintained by ENV D; game/tests/d/test_cower_offsets.gd re-measures every civilian look of p5_cast.json (CPU-skinned through cower_stand) and fails on a missing, short or stale entry. ENV A applies it.
